_readme: FS5 black-oil regression pin. Generated from the engine BEFORE any compositional UI wiring; the jest gate asserts the black-oil default path reproduces these numbers exactly (1e-9 rel). Regenerate ONLY for a deliberate, reviewed black-oil change: node tools with the snippet in blackOilSnapshot.test.js. Changed on purpose 2026-10-02 (FLUID-U1-008): separator totals are summed before rounding (650.1 became 650 scf/STB for a 650 solution GOR), the separator warning was reworded, and (FLUID-U1-007) Bo above the bubble point is the integral of the co the table prints (1.3458 became 1.3387 at 4,998 psia). Changed on purpose 2026-10-02 (FLUID-U2-006): the z-factor is Dranchuk-Abou-Kassem from the canonical engines library (was Papay): Z at Pb 0.8873 became 0.8710, Bg at Pb 0.000985 became 0.000966 RB/scf; gas viscosity moves with Z. Changed on purpose 2026-10-03 (FLUID-U2-022): salinity enters Bw through the Numbere-Brigham-Standing brine ratio (35,000 ppm: Bw at Pb 1.0339 became 1.0349).
warnings: Separator results use a black-oil staged-liberation approximation (a partition of the GOR by the Rs correlation). A compositional flash needs the compositional model.
